evidence.name: Screen field: Link your Terms of Use page
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Link your Terms of Use page" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Link your Terms of Use page
sections.description: The full https:// web address your Terms of Use link opens when tapped. Fill this in for any paid funnel — a live Terms link is effectively required by app stores and ad networks. Leaving it empty disables the link and leaves your paywall non-compliant, so never ship an ad-ready paywall with this blank.
